sessions.title: DBA in the Driver's Seat: Operating Autonomous AI Database
sessions.description: What does the DBA role look like when the database handles much of its own routine administration? Autonomous AI Database gives DBAs the opportunity to spend less time maintaining individual databases and more time operating a secure, resilient, and efficient database service.
